title: Mediation Analysis with Multiple Imputation for Missing Data
text: missingmed runs regression (GLM)-based mediation analysis across incomplete data pools Rubin’s rules. missing-data middle mediationverse: thin orchestration layer fits analysis medfit delegates inference RMediation. Two estimators share one S7 pipeline: Multiple imputation (method = "mi") — pools per-imputation fits Rubin’s rules. Inverse-probability weighting (method = "ipw") — reweights complete cases (stabilized weights, trimming, HC sandwich SEs). indirect effect provides Monte-Carlo confidence interval D4-stacked MBCO likelihood-ratio test (, unlike pooling, respects union-null geometry H0: ab = 0).
